title: LOREVI production report pipeline readiness review
summary: The team approved a production-grade report pipeline with explicit layout measurement, semantic pagination, immutable asset reuse, and stage-level diagnostics. Dense architecture content must remain complete, move as one coherent block when necessary, and never terminate the whole export because a local section needs more room.

insights.title: Measurement must match drawing
insights.description: Section height includes headings, icon gutters, descriptions, process connectors, and all internal spacing.

insights.title: Density is a pagination signal
insights.description: When the block cannot fit cleanly on page one, it moves coherently instead of clipping or aborting export.

insights.title: Warm exports should reuse immutable bytes
insights.description: Versioned font files and header artwork stay cached for the browser session.

decisions.title: Use at most four sections per row
decisions.description: Additional sections flow into another row while preserving their logical order.

decisions.title: Expose generation timings
decisions.description: Diagnostics cover dependencies, assets, composition, layout, render, and save.

decisions.title: Protect production with the full gate
decisions.description: Merge follows rendered artifact inspection and green content-integrity checks.

risks.title: Under-allocated architecture
risks.description: A simplified estimate may let text cross a card boundary.
risks.mitigation: Share the renderer's wrapping and geometry rules in layout measurement.

risks.title: Silent final-item loss
risks.description: Array slicing can remove meaningful content without raising an error.
risks.mitigation: Assert a unique final sentinel in extracted PDF text.

tasks.task: Render the dense English fixture and inspect both pages
Verify a warm export performs no immutable asset requests
Confirm missing Owner and Due Date placeholders are visible
Approve the final artifact against the acceptance gate
